blurb: A `stub` substitutes one of the capabilities the unit under test depends on: one the context declares, or reaches through a `consumes`. Any other name, including a misspelt one, leaves nothing to substitute. A commons has no capabilities, so it cannot be stubbed at all. Name a capability of the target, or add the `consumes` it needs. See `bynk.stub.unknown_op` for a wrong operation.
summary: A test `stub` overrides a capability the unit under test does not consume.
